en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide street and a large, symmetrical school building in front of a hilly townscape. The multi‑storey structure has a stone base, tall rectangular windows, and a central entrance with small columns. Behind it, a hill dotted with houses rises, topped by a prominent church building. Handwritten Hungarian text appears at the bottom of the image, identifying the location and the institution.
